trials.description: negative RS60, full replacement of B00 high-event score

feature_definitions.event: Close_t/common_share_scale > max(High/common_share_scale over previous 250 listing observations); strict; all 250 required
feature_definitions.rs60: e_i,s=raw_return_i,s-beta_i,s*topix_return_s; M_i,t=sum(e_i,t-j,j=1..60); RS=2*(daily average-tie percentile_rank(M)-daily mean percentile_rank(M)); missing RS filled 0, exactly inherited
feature_definitions.share_scale: cumulative observed AdjustmentFactor since listing segment; raw H/L/C divided by scale
feature_definitions.listing_segment: reset when absence exceeds 20 observed market dates
feature_definitions.missing: nonpositive/nonfinite raw price -> NaN; invalid AdjustmentFactor -> error; missing 60-window -> centered RS=0; missing event history -> no event

model: No fitting, single negative RS60 rank

parameters.information_timestamp: t Close for event; RS ends t-1; no future input
parameters.injection: non-event raw B00; high event 0.5+0.5*pct_rank(-RS60 within daily high events); per-listing EWM adjust=False alpha=.25
parameters.short_policy: B00 low-event raw scores unchanged; no short redesign. Official all-universe ranking may indirectly change final short weights; quantify it.
parameters.evaluation_calendar: Train 2011-2016; Valid 2016-2026. Remove final 2 signal dates of each calendar-year/split group before metrics. Compute continuous portfolio first, retaining turnover across omitted dates.
parameters.valid_history: concatenate Train feature history with Valid feature inputs, no Train labels in Valid inference

selection_rule.primary_variable: raw relative_strength_60 daily event Spearman vs official target; equal-weight mean across eligible dates, not row-pooled correlation
selection_rule.robustness: remove most supportive 1% of daily raw IC values: remaining mean <= -0.01; drop largest absolute 1% daily Q5-Q1 spreads: remaining mean < 0
selection_rule.train_direction: raw IC<0 and raw Q5-Q1<0 required for Train/Valid consistency; Train size is not evidence
selection_rule.go: all frozen signal criteria pass; numerical GO only, independent confirmation unavailable because Valid already disclosed
selection_rule.no_go: any signal criterion fails -> CLOSED; no portfolio rescue
selection_rule.secondary: portfolio metrics only interpreted if primary passes; mechanical ledgers saved regardless to fulfill audit artifacts
